change_summary: Reduce Redis TTL for user-session cache from 3600s to 300s to address stale session data bug (JIRA-4821)
diff_or_config:
# redis-config/session-cache.yaml
- ttl_seconds: 3600
+ ttl_seconds: 300
  max_memory: 4gb
  eviction_policy: allkeys-lru
  cluster: session-redis-prod.internal:6379
service_context: auth-service (Node.js), Redis 7.0 cluster, ~200k active sessions at peak. Session cache hit ratio currently 94%.
deployment_plan: Deploy config change to all auth-service instances simultaneously via ConfigMap update.
slo_reliability_impact: Cache miss rate will increase ~12x during transition. Auth latency p99 may spike from 45ms to 200ms+ until cache warms.
blast_radius: All authenticated users. Downstream services: order-service, profile-service, notification-service.

seeded_gaps.description: All-at-once deployment with no staged rollout for high-impact cache change
Rollback plan is vague ('can revert config') with no specific steps or timing
No alerting evidence for cache miss rate or auth latency degradation
No owner or on-call identified for the change
No validation or testing evidence provided
